catalog.name: telemetry integrity
catalog.outcome: PASS — broken on purpose: capture with no opt-in records nothing; an unlisted field is rejected; a seeded key/address is scrubbed; single-consent egresses nothing; telemetry/feedback import no verdict-path module

catalog.name: re-score honesty
catalog.outcome: PASS — every post-mortem verdict recomputes as the engine's actual output; every cell SAMPLE-labeled (allSample=true); a tampered SOLID does not match the engine (the recompute control bites)

catalog.name: kill-criterion + live parity
catalog.outcome: PASS — the criterion is concrete/numeric/pre-registered and immutable-without-disclosure (commitHash matches); live paid-parity is OWED-OPERATOR-GATED (hermetic S48 stands in, cc7e5e5a)

probes.name: telemetry OFF by default — capture with no opt-in records nothing
probes.detail: no env → no capture; the reason is honest, not silent

probes.name: manifest-drift rejected — an unlisted field (a typed pool address) fails the strict schema
probes.detail: a field absent from the pinned manifest is dropped — no covert capture

probes.name: the seeded-key/address grep — the scrubber drops both from any field
probes.detail: the seeded key → <redacted:NAME>, the address → <address>; neither survives export

probes.name: single-consent share egresses nothing — a SECOND explicit consent is required
probes.detail: one consent → blocked; two consents → the shared payload IS the scrubbed local export

probes.name: the re-score post-mortems recompute — every verdict IS the engine's output; every cell SAMPLE-labeled (no fabricated REAL)
probes.detail: Scorecard.score on the recorded facts reproduces each verdict; allSample=true

probes.name: the kill-criterion is pre-registered + immutable-without-disclosure (the commitHash matches the content)
probes.detail: an edit to any threshold changes the hash → a visible re-pin, never a silent goalpost move

probes.name: the /feedback door — a hostile non-JSON body is a sentence, never a crash
probes.detail: HTTP 400; an honest sentence, no stack

probes.name: the /feedback door — an oversized body is refused at the cap (8KiB)
the /postmortems export — every subject SAMPLE-labeled, no leaked secret
the seeded-key grep — the whole probe transcript is secret-free
probes.detail: the seeded key appears nowhere in any probe response or detail

adversarialProofs.attack: capture covertly (no opt-in), smuggle an unlisted field, leak a key/address in a field, egress on one consent
adversarialProofs.observed: off-by-default records nothing; the strict schema drops the unlisted field; the scrubber redacts the key + masks the address; sharing needs a SECOND consent and only the scrubbed local payload leaves
adversarialProofs.conclusion: no covert anything — the posture holds under a hostile hand

adversarialProofs.attack: flatter the artifact — assert a REAL cell we did not fetch, or a verdict the engine does not produce (a SOLID 'we'd have caught it')
adversarialProofs.observed: allSample=true (no REAL cell claimed); every recorded verdict recomputes as Scorecard.score's actual output (UNVERIFIED + the adverse structural flags); a tampered SOLID fails the recompute
adversarialProofs.conclusion: the credibility artifact cannot lie — it is the engine's actual output on SAMPLE-labeled facts

adversarialProofs.attack: move the goalpost — grade the probe on a criterion edited after the invites
adversarialProofs.observed: the criterion is committed with a commitHash; any threshold edit changes the hash → a visible, disclosed re-pin, never silent
adversarialProofs.conclusion: the probe grades itself against a bar set before the throw

operatorSession.owed: AF1 (the Operator real-screen session, incl. the telemetry disclosure/opt-in flow + the re-score view) · AF2 (the browser/AT/viewport a11y pass) · AF4 (the FIRST live paid-key parity run) — recorded in data/honesty/probe-prereqs.json with concrete checklists
operatorSession.whyGap: this session was agent-executed; the agent can DRIVE the flows but CANNOT SIT the Operator's real-screen session and does not hold the Operator's paid keys (LN5). Recorded as OWED-OPERATOR-GATED, never simulated. The probe verdict is PROBE-ARMED / READY-PENDING-OPERATOR.

twoVerdicts.proof: the telemetry/feedback/re-score surfaces touch no scored module (verdict-path-forbidden, grep-walled); the Stamp still renders GO/NO-GO/INSUFFICIENT/UNAVAILABLE, never a scorecard pill; instrumenting the probe weakened no wall
